```python
from gurobipy import *

def solve_problem():
    # Create a new model
    m = Model("Optimization_Problem")

    # 2. Variables
    vars = {}
    lin_expr = 0
    vars['Var_0'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=10.08, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='Var_0')
    lin_expr += 5.28 * vars['Var_0']
    vars['Var_1'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=9.41, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='Var_1')
    lin_expr += 6.93 * vars['Var_1']

    m.setObjective(lin_expr, GRB.MAXIMIZE)

    # 3. Constraints
    m.addConstr(7.01 * vars['Var_0'] + 8.61 * vars['Var_1'] <= 19.62, name='C0')
    m.addConstr(4.94 * vars['Var_0'] + 0.43 * vars['Var_1'] <= 3.48, name='C1')
    m.addConstr(1.21 * vars['Var_0'] + 8.08 * vars['Var_1'] <= 16.73, name='C2')
    m.addConstr(8.05 * vars['Var_0'] + 6.64 * vars['Var_1'] <= 16.18, name='C3')
    m.addConstr(6.9 * vars['Var_1'] <= 14.64, name='C4')

    # 4. Optimize
    m.optimize()
    return m
```

Subject: Choosing Our Q1 Mix to Maximize Contribution Within Resource Limits

Team,

We need to choose the mix of two offerings for the upcoming planning window to maximize total contribution while staying inside our operating limits. All commitments must be made in whole engagements only (no fractional runs).

Levers we can move

- Enterprise Migration Packages (Aurora track)
  • Value: Each package contributes 5.28 units of net margin to the quarter.
  • Resource draw per package:
    - 7.01 senior-strategist day-equivalents
    - 4.94 creative/legal review day-equivalents
    - 1.21 cloud-compute credit units
    - 8.05 field travel day-equivalents
    - 0 media inventory slots (no draw on our media pool)
  • Scale limits: We may schedule anywhere from 0 up to 10.08 of these packages in the period, but we must commit them as whole packages only.

- Digital Campaign Blitz (Nova track)
  • Value: Each campaign contributes 6.93 units of net margin to the quarter.
  • Resource draw per campaign:
    - 8.61 senior-strategist day-equivalents
    - 0.43 creative/legal review day-equivalents
    - 8.08 cloud-compute credit units
    - 6.64 field travel day-equivalents
    - 6.90 media inventory slots
  • Scale limits: We may schedule anywhere from 0 up to 9.41 of these campaigns in the period, again only in whole campaigns.

Facility specs and market limits we must respect

- Senior-strategist availability: no more than 19.62 day-equivalents across all work.
- Creative/legal review capacity: no more than 3.48 day-equivalents across all work.
- Cloud-compute budget: no more than 16.73 credit units across all work.
- Field travel capacity: no more than 16.18 day-equivalents across all work.
- Media inventory: no more than 14.64 slots across all work.

Our aim is to select the combination of Aurora packages and Nova campaigns that yields the highest total net margin (using the 5.28 and 6.93 per-unit contributions above) without breaching any of the resource ceilings listed.
